caption: The drawing consists of a large expanse of off-white or beige paper with a small, rectangular section located near the center, slightly below the midpoint. Inside this smaller section are two nearly identical geometric shapes placed side by side, each with a rounded rectangle outline. Each shape is outlined in blue with a series of evenly spaced blue dots along the border. Within each blue-bordered shape, there is a central gray area that features a symmetrical, stylized design resembling a geometric container, comprised of straight and curved lines in black and gray. The interior design of each shape is accented with a horizontal black line across the upper third, and a V-like shape at the bottom, with the gray color filling most of the inner area. The two shapes are separated by a narrow vertical white space within the smaller white rectangle. The overall composition is minimal, with the detailed geometric drawings occupying a small portion of the entire paper, and the majority of the paper left blank.
title: Neck Buckle
